name: Volatility Surface Triangle (ATM Straddle vs 25-Delta Risk Reversal vs 25-Delta Butterfly)
summary: Trade the three FX-convention surface quantities as separate instruments - level (ATM straddle), skew (25-delta risk reversal) and curvature (25-delta butterfly) - isolating whichever one is mispriced while neutralizing the other two.

legs.strike_rule: LEVEL leg: ATM straddle, delta 0.50 call, traded when ATM IV is cheap or rich versus its own history
legs.dte_rule: 30-60 DTE, one expiry for the whole triangle

legs.strike_rule: LEVEL leg: the matching ATM put at the same strike
SKEW leg: 25-delta call, bought (or sold) against the 25-delta put to trade the risk reversal - RR = IV(25d call) - IV(25d put)
SKEW leg: 25-delta put; sold in the long-RR direction. MUST be cash-secured or wrapped in a put spread to stay at level 3

max_profit: Depends on which parameter is traded: skew and curvature trades are bounded by the strike geometry; the level trade is unbounded on the upside of a straddle
max_loss: Bounded by the debit for long-only expressions; for the short side of any parameter, bounded only if the short is cash-secured or spread-wrapped - which this system requires
breakevens: Expressed in vol points, not price: the trade wins when the quoted parameter (ATM IV, RR, or fly) converges toward the modeled fair value

greeks.delta: hedged to zero and rebalanced daily; the trade is about the surface, not the price
greeks.gamma: depends on the leg - the ATM straddle carries the most
greeks.vega: the point of the trade: ATM vega for level, skew vega (vanna) for the RR, curvature vega (volga) for the fly

when_to_use: When the mispricing is in the SHAPE of the surface rather than in a direction: skew steeper than any point in its two-year range, or the 25-delta fly (smile curvature) collapsed after a calm stretch. The bank's existing butterfly and risk-reversal entries are payoff shapes; this entry trades them as quoted surface parameters, which is a different decision rule entirely.
entry_rules: Compute and store the three parameters daily for SPY and QQQ: ATM IV at 30 days, RR_25 = IV(25d call) - IV(25d put), FLY_25 = (IV(25d call) + IV(25d put))/2 - ATM IV. Two years of history is required before any trade.
Trade ONE parameter per position. Neutralize the others by construction (e.g. a pure fly trade must be vega-neutral to ATM at entry within 10%).
Entry threshold: the traded parameter must be beyond its 10th or 90th percentile over 2 years. Nothing inside that band is a trade.

LEVEL 3 CONSTRAINT: any short option in the expression must be either cash-secured or converted to a spread. A 25-delta short put in a long-RR expression becomes a 25-delta/15-delta put credit spread.
Delta-hedge daily; without the hedge the position's P/L is dominated by direction and the surface view is unobservable.
Total defined risk <= 2% of equity per parameter trade; at most 2 open at once.
SPY/QQQ only; all legs one expiry; OI >= 250 per leg.
management_rules: Take profit when the traded parameter reverts to its median, or at 50% of modeled maximum gain.
Stop when the parameter moves 1 further standard deviation against the entry - surfaces trend, and a rich skew can get richer.
Re-hedge delta daily at 15:45 ET; re-check that the non-traded parameters are still neutralized weekly and rebuild if the drift exceeds 25%.
Roll the whole expression at 21 DTE or close it; never let the 25-delta strikes drift into 40-delta strikes and keep calling it a 25-delta trade.
exit_rules: Close all legs at least 2 trading days before expiry.
Close any short leg at extrinsic < $0.10 or |delta| >= 0.85; short calls close before every ex-dividend date while ITM.
Flatten the share hedge in the same session as the options.
If the parameter history pipeline goes stale (no update for 2 sessions), close - the trade cannot be evaluated without it.
assignment_risk: Only from short legs, and every short leg here is required to be cash-secured or spread-wrapped, so assignment is defined. The practical risk is that a 25-delta short put drifts to 60 delta while the position is held for a vol-point reason rather than a price reason - the delta and extrinsic guards override the surface view every time.
buying_power: Debits plus the cash or spread width behind any short leg, plus share-hedge margin.
liquidity_needs: Reliable 25-delta quotes on both sides in one expiry; SPY and QQQ only.
common_mistakes: Trading two parameters at once and being unable to attribute P/L; using a payoff-shaped butterfly (equal strike widths) when the surface fly is defined by equal deltas; skipping the delta hedge; treating the bank's existing risk-reversal entry as the same trade - it is not, it is the payoff, not the parameter.
zero_dte_notes: Not applicable - 0DTE surface parameters are not stable enough to trade as parameters.
family: Completeness gap-fill (cross-family): ratio/naked-financed put and call structures, quantity-unbalanced condors and strangles, stock+option overlays and monetizations, capital-protection and hybrid builds, 0DTE four-leg income, volatility-surface and relative-value trades, event-driven overlays, and roll/adjustment structures
